name: Vendor linked to employee or without verifiable existence
description: Vendor has no verifiable address, tax number or deliveries, or shares address or bank details with an employee.
fp: New or very small vendors and sole traders may use home addresses, and employees may legitimately be related to vendors with disclosure.

sources.text: OECD, Recommendation of the Council on Public Procurement (2015)
OECD, Preventing Corruption in Public Procurement (2016)
OECD, Guidelines for Fighting Bid Rigging in Public Procurement (2009)
FATF, Laundering the Proceeds of Corruption (2011)
ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)
Fraud Advisory Panel (UK), guidance on internal fraud (general)
COSO and ACFE, Fraud Risk Management Guide (2016)

links.name: Phantom or fictitious supplier on vendor master
links.ctx: Vendor with no verifiable address, tax number or deliveries shares details with an employee or another vendor.
links.fp: Data entry errors can create apparent duplicates.

links.name: Vendor with staff-linked address or bank details
links.ctx: Procurement or payment to entity linked to an employee.
